engine: SQLite via the native SQLite driver
case: Grouped MIN over mixed STRICT ANY storage classes and typed CSV re-import
contract: SQLite MIN returns the native minimum storage value for INTEGER, REAL, TEXT and BLOB groups; an all-NULL group remains SQL NULL.
A mixed INTEGER/TEXT group follows SQLite's native storage-class ordering and selects the INTEGER value.
A marker-shaped string remains TEXT and is not confused with the CSV type marker.
Computed results are exported and imported through the app's typed CSV path; restored typeof() and exact values match the source results.
The computed result column retains fallback metadata rather than claiming the declared STRICT ANY storage class.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-app sqlite_min_any_csv_round_trip_preserves_runtime_storage_classes -- --test-threads=1
